title: •Walker Sighting
caption: •Walker Sighting (V)
game_text: _While an AT-AT or AT-ST on table, destiny +3._ ▲ Concussion Grenade, Logistical Delay, or Panic. {sense} OR If opponent’s AT-AT or AT-ST on table, peek at the top card of their Reserve Deck; may use 2 Force to make it lost.
lore: “Echo station, 3TA. We have spotted Imperial walkers.” A Rebel tactic is to put as much ground as possible between walkers and Rebel troops, allowing time to prepare a defense.
